campaign.noticeTitle: Notice of intent to pursue a municipal initiative petition
campaign.noticeAddress: To Mayor Caroline Torosis, Mayor Pro Tem Jesse Zwick, and the Santa Monica City Council
campaign.noticeParagraph1: Digital-UNI has formally notified City leadership of its intent to pursue a municipal initiative petition asking Santa Monica voters whether the Civic Auditorium should be evaluated and reserved for transformation into Santa Monica’s First AI-Native Private High School, an applied AI education campus, and a workforce and compute center.
campaign.noticeParagraph2: The proposed measure would seek a transparent City evaluation of landmark preservation, an AI high school, workforce programs, compute infrastructure, and approved shared athletics programming. It would not itself grant Digital-UNI ownership, a lease, funding, permits, accreditation, or development approval.
campaign.noticeParagraph3: Historic Belmar Park is a 3.5-acre municipal sports complex adjacent to the Civic. AI Pioneers soccer and football, youth clinics, and sports analytics would require City permits, scheduling, existing community-use protections, and appropriate athletics approvals.
campaign.noticeParagraph4: This community campaign is notice and public outreach—not the statutory Notice of Intention, authorization to circulate petitions, or a legally valid ballot signature. Formal qualification must follow the California Elections Code, Santa Monica Municipal Code, City Clerk procedures, signature verification, and required public action.
campaign.noticeDocumentTitle: Formal Notice to the Mayor and City Council
campaign.noticeDocumentDescription: Read the signed-format, one-page notice setting out the proposed campus, field strategy, campaign intent, and legal status.
campaign.publicProcessText: Community support can demonstrate public interest, but it cannot replace land-use review, a City transaction, historic-preservation requirements, school authorization, or the formal municipal initiative process.
campaign.deckTitle: Santa Monica AI High School investor deck
campaign.deckDescription: Review the site strategy, AI Pioneers team identity, Grades 9–12 curriculum, applied AI and GPU infrastructure, founder background, operating model, and phased capital approach.
campaign.deckFrameLabel: Digital-UNI Santa Monica AI High School investor deck
campaign.deckMobileText: The full 10-slide investor deck is available as a high-resolution PDF and opens in a new browser tab.
campaign.supportTitle: Add your name to the campaign
campaign.supportIntro: Santa Monica residents, parents, students, educators, neighborhood leaders, businesses, and community partners may register support and receive project updates.
campaign.legalText: This online form records support for Digital-UNI’s civic campaign. It is not an electronic signature on a municipal initiative petition. The City states that ballot qualification requires the State Elections Code process and signatures from 10% of registered City voters for an initiative, or 15% for a charter amendment.
